Reproduce the verification

The project pins Lean 4.24.0 and the exact mathlib commit. The audit reads the compiler’s checked environment and traverses the actual proof terms.

lake exe cache get
lake build
lake env lean Audit.lean
python3 scripts/verify_audit.py

Kernel dependencies

These are Lean’s standard classical dependencies. The audit rejects additional axioms and proof placeholders.
Coverage policy
“Complete” means the stated mathematical conclusions have corresponding checked results. “Equivalent form” identifies a faithful alternative formulation. “Partial” names the unclosed implications explicitly.
Exact hypotheses matter. A theorem supplied with a source-family interface is distinguished from a theorem constructing that interface from the original data.
Pinned mathlib
What this release does not assert
The formal scope is the numbered mathematical statements and the explicitly mapped identities. Numerical illustrations, literature attribution and novelty require their own evidence. This article and its formalization do not assert a proof of Sendov’s conjecture.
